name: Vase
definition: open vessel made to hold cut or artificial flowers or to stand as an ornament; a tulip vase is a vase.

name: Ginger jar
definition: rounded lidded jar made for display.

name: Decorative urn
definition: Large footed vessel made as an ornament, indoors or in the garden (a cremation urn is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).

name: Decorative bottle
definition: bottle made to be displayed, not to hold a drink.

name: Decorative bowl
definition: Bowl made to be looked at or to hold small decorative items (a bowl made to hold food is in Kitchen & Dining).

name: Snow globe
definition: sealed liquid-filled globe holding a scene and loose particles that fall when shaken.

name: Decorative wall panel
definition: carved, fretted or moulded panel made to hang on a wall as ornament.

name: Wall sticker
definition: Self-adhesive vinyl or film motif, pattern or lettering applied to a wall, window or furniture to decorate it.

name: Decorative replica weapon
definition: Replica sword, gun or other weapon made for display that cannot injure, decorative wushu implements included.

name: Deactivated ordnance
definition: Bomb, grenade, mine or artillery piece made inert and kept for display.

name: Wall mirror
definition: mirror with a hanging fitting, made to hang on a wall.

name: Floor mirror
definition: full-length mirror made to lean against a wall from the floor, with no hanging fitting.

name: Standing mirror
definition: full-length mirror held in its own free-standing frame, often tilting.

name: Table mirror
definition: Plain mirror on a stand made to sit on a table or dresser (a grooming mirror is in Personal Care & Beauty).

name: Picture frame
definition: empty frame made to hold and display a picture or photograph.

name: Container candle
definition: candle poured into and burned in its own jar or vessel.

name: Tealight
definition: small candle in a shallow metal or plastic cup.

name: Votive candle
definition: short candle made to burn standing in a holder that contains the melted wax.

name: Taper candle
definition: long, slender candle made for a candlestick.

name: Pillar candle
definition: thick free-standing candle that burns without a container.

name: Candle holder
definition: Open holder made to hold a lit candle.

name: Candle snuffer
definition: tool with a small bell on a handle made to put out a candle flame.

name: Reed diffuser
definition: vessel of scented oil with reeds that draw it up and release it into a room.

name: Electric diffuser
definition: Powered device made to release fragrance into a room.

name: Wax melt
definition: scented wax piece made to be melted in a warmer, not burned.

name: Wax warmer
definition: Burner or electric warmer made to melt wax melts or oil.

name: Room spray
definition: aerosol or pump spray made to scent a room.

name: Potpourri
definition: mixture of dried scented plant material displayed to scent a room.

name: Diffuser oil
definition: Essential or fragrance oil sold for a diffuser or burner (an oil sold to treat a condition is in Health, Medical & Mobility).

name: Stick incense
definition: incense formed on or as a stick, burned to scent a room.

name: Cone incense
definition: incense pressed into a cone.

name: Coil incense
definition: incense formed as a long-burning coil.

name: Incense burner
definition: Holder or burner made to burn incense for scenting the home (a burner for religious rites is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).

name: Smudge bundle
definition: Bound bundle of dried herbs burned to scent or cleanse a room, not made for a named rite.

name: Tree ornament
definition: ornament made to hang on a tree or festive display, whatever its theme.

name: Tree topper
definition: ornament made to sit on the top of a tree.

name: Garland
definition: long strand of foliage, tinsel, beads or other decoration made to drape or hang.

name: Bunting
definition: string of pennant-shaped flags hung as a festive decoration.

name: Paper streamer
definition: long strip or roll of paper hung or thrown as a party decoration.

name: Artificial Christmas tree
definition: Manufactured tree made to be decorated for Christmas (a real tree is in Plants & Living Cultures).

name: Festival doll display
definition: Set of dolls made to be displayed on tiers for a festival, not made for worship.

name: Entrance decoration
definition: Seasonal arrangement made to stand at an entrance for a festival.

name: Christmas cracker
definition: paper tube pulled apart by two people with a snap, holding small gifts.

name: Party popper
definition: hand-held device that bursts with a bang and throws out streamers.

name: Sparkler
definition: hand-held wire coated with a slow-burning pyrotechnic that throws sparks (B-19).

name: Firework
definition: pyrotechnic device made to give a display of light, colour or noise (B-19).

name: Fog machine
definition: machine that makes fog or haze for a party or display effect (K-145).

name: Artificial flower
definition: manufactured imitation of a flower, single stem or arranged.

name: Artificial plant
definition: manufactured imitation of a plant other than a flower, foliage and trees included (K-74).

name: Preserved plant
definition: real plant or moss treated so that it keeps its look without growing or care (K-74).

name: Dried flowers
definition: real flowers dried for display.

name: Garden statue
definition: statue made to stand outdoors as a garden ornament.

name: Garden gnome
definition: figure of a gnome made as a garden ornament.

name: Gazing ball
definition: reflective sphere on a stand made as a garden ornament.

name: Weathervane
definition: rotating ornament on a rod that turns to show the wind direction.

name: Wind chime
definition: set of hanging tubes, rods or bells that sound when moved by the wind.

name: Garden fountain
definition: Ornamental fountain or flowing-water feature for a garden (its pump is in Garden & Grounds).

name: National flag
definition: flag of a country, made to fly or hang.

name: State or territory flag
definition: flag of a state, province or territory.

name: Garden flag
definition: small flag made to hang from a garden stake or stand.

name: Pennant
definition: tapering flag, usually triangular.

name: Decorative windsock
definition: Windsock or streamer made as a garden, festive or decorative ornament (a windsock made to show wind direction or strength is in Optical & Scientific Instruments).

name: Hanging sign
definition: sign made to hang from a bracket, chain or cord.

name: Illuminated sign
definition: Neon or LED sign made to show a lit word or motif, a decorative light that spells a message included.

name: String light
definition: string of small lights made mainly as decoration (K-181).

name: Flameless candle
definition: battery or LED light made in the shape of a candle.

name: Lava lamp
definition: lamp in which heated wax rises and falls in a liquid, made mainly as decoration.

name: Decorative lantern
definition: Lantern made to stand or hang as decoration, lit or unlit, stone garden lanterns included.

name: Flagpole
definition: pole made to fly a flag (K-192).

name: Wreath
definition: Ring of foliage, flowers or other decoration made to hang on a door or wall as a seasonal or festive ornament (an Advent wreath made for worship is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).

name: Apothecary jar
definition: Straight-sided glass jar with a lid, often footed, made to stand on display (a jar made to store food is in Kitchen & Dining).

name: Feather banner
definition: tall narrow flag carried on a curved pole with a ground spike or base, made to stand outside as a sign or decoration.

name: Wind spinner
definition: garden ornament of vanes, cups or spirals that turns in the wind, staked or hung.

name: Garden pedestal or column
definition: ornamental pedestal, plinth or column made to stand in a garden, alone or carrying an urn, statue or gazing ball.

name: Scented sachet
definition: Small bag or pouch of scented material made to scent a drawer, wardrobe or room (an odour absorber is in Cleaning & Laundry).

name: Floating candle
definition: small, wide, flat candle made to float and burn on water in a bowl or vase.

name: Tree skirt
definition: cloth or mat laid round the foot of a Christmas tree to decorate it and hide the stand.

name: Christmas stocking
definition: large decorative sock made to hang at a fireplace or wall at Christmas and be filled with gifts.

name: Reusable Advent calendar
definition: Reusable display calendar of fabric, wood or card with numbered doors or pockets for the days before Christmas (one sold filled with confectionery is food; an Advent wreath is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).

name: Ornament hook
definition: wire or clip hook made to hang a tree ornament.

name: Mirror ball
definition: sphere covered in small mirrors, often turned by a motor, that scatters light as a party or display effect.

name: Wall vase
definition: flat-backed vase with a hanging fitting, made to hang on a wall.

name: House flag
definition: Decorative or seasonal flag made to fly from a pole bracket on a house (a country or state flag is listed under its own name).

name: Confetti
definition: small pieces of paper, foil or other material thrown or scattered as a party decoration.

name: Candlestick
definition: holder with a socket or spike made to hold one or more taper or pillar candles upright on a stem or base.

name: Tealight holder
definition: small open holder made to hold a tealight.

name: Loose incense
definition: Scented wood chips, resin or powder burned on charcoal or a heater to scent a room (incense for religious rites is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects).

name: Wall sign or plaque
definition: flat sign or plaque made to fix to or stand against a wall.
